item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
Issued at 05:00 PM 15 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Bukidnon(Lantapan, CityOfValencia, Maramag, SanFernando, Quezon, Baungon), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Siayan, Sindangan, Manukan, JoseDalman, LeonB.Postigo, Salug, Godod, Liloy, Labason), #ZamboangaDelSur(Dumingag, Midsalip, Bayog), #SurigaoDelSur(Lanuza, Lianga, Barobo), #AgusanDelSur(Prosperidad, Veruela, Bunawan, SantaJosefa, Trento, Rosario, SanFrancisco, Talacogon), #SultanKudarat(Lutayan, Lebak, Columbio, Esperanza, Lambayong), #MisamisOccidental(SapangDalaga, Concepcion, DonVictorianoChiongbian, Baliangao, Plaridel, Calamba), #ZamboangaSibugay(Kabasalan, Diplahan, Siay), #Basilan(CityOfIsabela, CityOfLamitan, Akbar, HadjiMohammadAjul, Tuburan), #SouthCotabato(Tantangan, Norala, SantoNiño, Banga, CityOfKoronadal, Surallah, LakeSebu), #DavaoDelNorte(Kapalong), #DavaoDeOro(Laak and Monkayo) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #AgusanDelSur(SanLuis, LaPaz, Esperanza, Loreto, Sibagat, CityOfBayugan), #Bukidnon(CityOfMalaybalay, ImpasugOng, Cabanglasan, Talakag), #ZamboangaDelNorte(SergioOsmeñaSr., Pres.ManuelA.Roxas, Katipunan, Mutia, LaLibertad, Piñan, DapitanCity, Rizal, Sibutad, Polanco, DipologCity), #SurigaoDelSur(SanMiguel), #SultanKudarat(Palimbang, Sen.NinoyAquino, Kalamansig, Bagumbayan, Isulan, CityOfTacurong and PresidentQuirino) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
